$comment: THE APP'S DESIGN, AS ONE JSON DOCUMENT (v2, 2026-10-31). The Designer agent reads this to know what it can change, and answers with a partial document of the same shape that is deep-merged into the person's current design. The phone draws every field here. Colours are #RRGGBB; null or absent = the app's own value. Text must stay readable: pageText on page and cardText on card at least 4.5:1, muted text 3:1.
mode: dark | light | adaptive — the app's light/dark setting (null = leave as is). A colour set is dark or light by its page colour.

colors.pageText: headings and body text on the page (the Home title area, lists outside cards)
colors.pageMuted: secondary text on the page (the date, hints)
colors.pageFaint: the faintest text on the page (timestamps)
colors.cardRaised: chips, fields and tiles that sit on a card
colors.cardBorder: the card's outline (null = the app's soft edge)
colors.cardText: the main text inside cards (titles, items)
colors.primary: the brand colour: buttons, the mic orb, the active tab, links, the selected state
colors.partner: the brand colour's gradient partner (orb, buttons, gradients)
colors.tertiary: a third accent (variety in icon tiles)
colors.headerTitle: the big title at the top of Home (null = the brand gradient)

background.style: ambient (the app's moving light) | gradient | plain
background.from: gradient start colour, top-left (null = from primary) — must clearly differ from `to`
background.to: gradient end colour, bottom-right (null = from partner)

cards.style: glass (the app's own) | solid | outlined | flat

typography.font: Space Grotesk | Manrope | Roboto (the fonts the app carries); null = the app's pairing

header.title: the words at the top of Home, max 24 characters (default MyAssistant)
header.showQuote: true | false — today's quote under the date

home.sections: ordered list of {id, visible}: ids play (Play my day button), agents (Your agents row), today (Today's cards: the person's reminders, agenda, calendar, missed calls — 'my reminders'/'my day' mean this), born (Born today), extras (Tips and extra cards), asks (Try asking chips), shortcuts (Quick tools), whatsnew (What's new), and card:<id> for custom cards.
home.$change: To rearrange Home answer changes.home = {"first": [ids for the very top, in order], "last": [ids for the end], "hide": [ids], "show": [ids]}

customCards: up to 8 of {id, title (max 40), accent (#RRGGBB), blocks: up to 8 of {type: text, value} | {type: list, source, label, limit 1-5} | {type: stat, source, label} | {type: button, label, ask (what tapping it asks the assistant)}}. Sources (the person's own data): reminders, calendar, shopping, habits, weather, news, brief.
